Researching spells and creating grimoires is a main part of being a mage. Start with making a runic scroll. Throw [Q] the scroll into an arclight furnace and acquire a spell cipher. The type of spell cipher can change depending on the essence used during essence infusion.

When you are ready to research spells, surround this block with magic runes using magic chalk and place the spell cipher in the gui itemslot. At this point, you will see a connection to the rust start to form. When this finishes gathering energy and is in the ready state, sit and go into meditation. Look at this block long enough to attempt to create a finished cipher to use in the oculus.

Beware, there is a chance of things going wrong while researching spells. A door once opened can be entered from either side...

These are blocks that mages can create to serve a specific purpose. Anyone can use these blocks, including non-magic users.

Utility blocks must be placed near a runestone to function. The potency depends on the runestone they are attached to.

• Arcanus runestone: 6 block radius
• Etherium runestone: 12 block radius
• Chimerite runestone: 18 block radius
This block can be recharged with the spell 'Transmutation' or by applying rusty dust directly to the block with Shift + Right mouse click. The charge amount depends on the block itself.

Rituals are a type of structured magic that relies on the correct placement of various runes and blocks to trigger an effect. This result can be as simple as creating a new object or spawning a rift.

With magic chalk in hand, press 'F' to open the menu. Select the ritual you want to perform, then Right mouse click to draw the sigil. [Sneak] + Right mouse click the sigil while holding magic chalk to view the position of blocks and see how many are missing or wrong. When all of the blocks are placed correctly, [Sneak] + Right mouse clicking the sigil will tell you what reagents you need. Throw [Q] these into the center of the ritual and cast 'Transmutation' on the sigil to activate it.

Only sigils should be used for the center, all other rune blocks should be regular 'magic runes'. All blocks are color coded the same for all rituals.

This block uses various tablets to perform a magical feat called 'synthesis' that creates new magical blocks and items.

Start with knapping specific stones to create blank tablets, then knapping the blank tablets to make the final finished tablets. With a finished tablet in hand, Right mouse click the 'tablet slot' of this block to insert it. A small portal will open above this block. All recipes have a 'charge cost' for using the portal. Casting 'Transmutation' on this block or the portal increases the stored charge.

To create something, throw [Q] the requested ingredients into the portal or Right mouse the portal and move items into it. If there is enough charge and the next ingredient is in the portal, crafting will automatically start. It will continue crafting items as long as it has the ingredients and charge to do so. Ingredients thrown [Q] in will not be absorbed into the portal if there isn't enough storage space in the portal. You can get additional information by using [Sneak] and looking at this block.

When rift anchors (rust crystal) are in range of a rift, they have a chance to transform temporarily into an 'unstable rust crystal'. Depth underground will dictate the crystal size. If the rift disappears, these crystals will slowly convert back into their original object.

When flowers or rift anchors (riftbloom) are in range of a rift, they have a chance to transform temporarily into an 'unstable rust plant'. When harvested with a knife, this plant has a chance of dropping seeds used to grow stable versions of the plant. If the rift disappears, unstable riftblooms will slowly convert back into their original object.

Rust plants are not affected by water, temperature, or light. They only need soil and time. Having a rift near by will accelerate the plant's growth speed. Running through these plants will cause damage.
